<!-- We say no to features that bloat scope. -->

## Problem

What problem are you solving? Specific use case, not "it would be nice if".

## Proposed solution

What you want `geo-audit` to do.

## Alternatives considered

What you tried instead. (`Surfer SEO`, custom script, etc.)

## Scope

- [ ] New CLI flag on existing module
- [ ] New module
- [ ] New integration (n8n, GitHub Action, etc.)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Other

## Are you willing to contribute the implementation?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No, but I can test
- [ ] No, I'm asking for the team to build it

## Why this fits the project

Why is this `geo-audit`'s job vs. a separate tool? What in the README
roadmap suggests this is in scope?
